_comment: Curated mapping from the goods description as it appears on an xClear job report
to a product in catalogue.json. This file is hand-maintained: the catalogue holds
scraped FACTS, this file holds the human DECISION about which product a job line is.
match        goods description from the job (matched case/punctuation-insensitively)
product      '<store>/<handle>' key into catalogue.json, or null if not published
description  retail description printed on the declaration
notes        extra lines printed under the ingredients (allergens, origin caveats)
unresolved   set when no published product exists; forces a review flag in the UI
Add a row here whenever a new job line comes through that the app can't match.
_componentAliasesComment: Gift sets list their contents using Vahdam's older product names -- 'Saffron Chai
Spiced Black Tea' is catalogued as 'Saffron Premium Masala Chai Tea'. Token overlap
cannot bridge that rename, so the decision is recorded here instead of guessed at.
Only add a row once you have confirmed the two names are the same tea.
